1742-1978-3363-7280.notablePrerequisites: The One Ring has a burden counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
1742-1978-3363-7280.description:
Animate The One Ring using Donatello.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and drawing a card for each burden counter on it.
Activate Skirge Familiar twice by discarding two cards, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping The One Ring.
Repeat from step 2.

4247-4484-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4247-4484-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating a 2/2 Zombie Druid creature token.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Zombie Druid.
When the Zombie Druid dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

728-2843-3175.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

3899-4871-5220-5849.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
3899-4871-5220-5849.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

Repeat.

206-2034-6970-7763-7850.description:
Cast Abby from the command zone by paying {1}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
Abby triggers, creating a number of 1/1 Fungus Zombie creature tokens named Cordyceps Infected equal to the amount of mana spent to cast it.
When Abby enters under an opponent's control, Mirror of Life Trapping triggers, exiling Abby.
Choose to return Abby from exile to the command zone.
Activate two Codryceps Infected tokens by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Cordyceps Infected token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat step 6 until you have enough mana to cast Abby.
Repeat from step 1.

1368-2706-4808.notablePrerequisites: You have at least six other cards in hand and/or graveyard.

Resolve Wheel of Fortune, causing each player to discard their hand and draw seven cards.
Cast Black Lotus from your graveyard for its escape cost by exiling 3 cards from your graveyard.
 Repeat.

Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.

5929-6264-7767.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to discard a card.
5929-6264-7767.description:
Discard a card.

Repeat from step 2.
5929-6264-7767.notes: You will need to break the combo, or you will eventually lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

5295-6006-7686.notablePrerequisites: You control four or more Squirrels.
5295-6006-7686.description:
Activate The Unbeatable Squirrel Girl by paying {1}{G}{G}{G}, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token for each Squirrel you control.
Activate four Squirrels by tapping them, adding {1}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat
5295-6006-7686.notes: You'll create double as many Squirrels each loop. All Squirrels beyond the first four will be untapped and can be used to add additional mana.

Blink Recruiter of the Guard using Deadeye Navigator.
When Recruiter of the Guard enters, it triggers, searching your library for Timestream Navigator and putting it into your hand.
Cast Timestream Navigator by paying {1}{U}.

Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.

3581-4390-5078-6757-7633.easyPrerequisites: You control two other untapped artifacts.
3581-4390-5078-6757-7633.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate Meria's second ability by tapping two artifacts, exiling Sensei's Divining Top with the ability to play it until end of turn.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from exile by paying {1}
Kykar and Ravenous Robots triggers, creating a 1/1 Robot artifact creature token and a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Weapons Manufacturing triggers, creating a Munitions token.
Activate Kykar by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Repeat.

648-1494-6730.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill a creature.
648-1494-6730.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cast Sin either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable. As it enters, remove all the counters from the Fractal and put twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Kill Sin. When it dies, it second ability triggers, putting its counters on Sage of Hours and shuffling Sin into your library.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to get an extra turn for each five +1/+1 counters removed from it.
648-1494-6730.notes: You can remove counters from other permanents in step 2 to get more counters as desired. The number of extra turns you will get will maximize using the following formula: 2*(your deck size + the number of counters on artifacts, creatures and enchantments)/5, rounded down. If desired, you can take two turns to execute the combo to spread the mana cost out by doing step 1 the first turn and all other steps on the second turn.

Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

328-997-2173-5220.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-997-2173-5220.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

2034-4215-5630-6872.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Moss-Pit Skeleton.
When Moss-Pit Skeleton dies, Long Feng and Verdant Succession trigger.
Resolve the Long Feng trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Moss-Pit Skeleton triggers, putting itself from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for Moss-Pit Skeleton and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

2438-3771-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
2438-3771-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: Animar has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
2438-3771-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability and Animar trigger.
Resolve the Animar trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it
Resolve the Geralf trigger, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
2438-3771-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1987-4276-4823-4863.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.

Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Timeless Witness.
When Revolutionist and Timeless Witness enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-4276-4823-4863.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

3719-5300-5626.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least eight artifacts.
You have a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 2 or less.

Cast Ruthless Technomancer by paying {3}{B}.
When Ruthless Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice Akiri and create at least eight Treasure tokens.
Activate seven Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}{B}{B}.
Activate Ruthless Technomancer by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing a Treasure, returning Akiri from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Ruthless Technomancer, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning a creature with mana value 2 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing the creature returned in step 7, and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Ruthless Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
3719-5300-5626.notes: If Akiri has power 9 or greater, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana, allowing you to recur any other creature(s) using Ruthless Technomancer. You may start the combo with fewer artifacts if you have mana to compensate until Akiri has power 8 or greater.

When Clone enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Wispweaver Angel.
When Wispweaver Angel enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking Clone. Choose to have Clone enter the battlefield as a copy of Wispweaver Angel.
